title: 93% of gap closures record no closed_reason, so law 7's gap triple cannot be measured and bookkeeping is indistinguishab
description:
93% of gap closures record no closed_reason, so law 7's gap triple cannot be measured and bookkeeping is indistinguishable from work.

MEASURED 2026-09-08 over the full gap store. Of all closed gaps, closed_reason is None on 1,744 rows. Breaking down what those None-reason closures actually are:
  auto_draft_decision:*        1,630  (93%)
  other                           97
  real gap (has an edit_site)     55  (3%)
  uninterpolated placeholder       2

CONSEQUENCE, OBSERVED DIRECTLY. Any aggregate that groups closures by day reads as though self-development output grew roughly twentyfold over the week: close-on-land closures went from ~1-6/day at the start of September to 81, 117 and 135/day on 09-05 through 09-07. Split by what the closed rows ARE, that surge is almost entirely auto_draft_decision bookkeeping - 124 of 135 on 09-07, 62 of 64 on 09-08 - while closures of gaps that carry an edit_site run 0-6 per day and are FLAT. An operator measuring progress from the closure stream will conclude the substrate is compounding when the underlying work rate has not changed. This is not hypothetical: it happened during this analysis and was caught only by sampling closed rows and reading their ids.

WHY IT MATTERS TO LAW 7. The gap triple is close rate, close latency, and durability. Two of the three are computed off the closure stream. With 93% of closures carrying no reason, close rate cannot distinguish a landed fix from a decision record being tidied up, and median close latency is dominated by whichever population is larger rather than by how fast real gaps get fixed. The law prescribes measuring progress this way and the data cannot currently support it.

WHAT WOULD FIX IT. Every close should record why. The paths that close a gap already know: close-on-land knows it saw a genuine land signal, the pending-verify sweep knows it measured the condition absent (it already writes landed_verified), and expiry knows it expired (it already writes expired_not_redetected). The gap is the close-on-land path and whatever closes auto_draft_decision rows, which write nothing. Giving those two a reason - even a coarse one such as landed_on_origin and decision_record_settled - makes the triple computable and separates work from housekeeping in every downstream aggregate.

SECOND, SMALLER DEFECT FOUND ALONGSIDE. Two gaps exist whose id contains an uninterpolated template placeholder, including one whose entire id is the literal {{dispatch_id}}. A placeholder reached the gap store as a durable record and was then closed, which means at least one gap-creating path emits its template rather than its value.

FALSIFIER. Recompute the closed_reason census. The defect is resolved when the share of closed gaps with closed_reason None falls well below 93%, and when close-on-land closures of gaps carrying an edit_site can be counted separately from decision-record closures without reading gap ids.
